title: Microsoft Purview: new Data Security Posture Management experience with objectives, AI observability and agents
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents explicit opt-in for DSPM analytics processing, which the briefing reports as unstated. The statement that scheduled SCU consumption continues until a schedule is removed also goes beyond the documented scheduling behaviour. The listed control paths and role-group command are supported.

claims.claim: Purview role-group membership is managed at Settings > Roles and scopes > Role groups > Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions > role group > Edit > Edit members of the role group > Choose users.
claims.quote: Go to **Settings** > **Roles and scopes** ... Select **Role groups** ... On **Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions** ... Select **Edit** ... On **Edit members of the role group**, select **Choose users** or **Choose groups**.

claims.claim: Add-RoleGroupMember -Identity "<role-group>" -Member "<user-UPN>" adds a user to a Purview role group.
claims.quote: Use the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to add members to a management role group. ... The Identity parameter specifies the role group to add a member to. ... User ID or user principal name (UPN)

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: DSPM's default is unknown, and Microsoft has not stated what starts without administrator setup.
claims.quote: **Opt-in analytics processing**: Data Security Posture Management requires explicit opt-in before processing organizational data. Analytics in both Insider Risk Management and DLP must be enabled before Data Security Posture Management can generate insights.
claims.fix: Set defaultState to admin-opt-in. Replace both broad unstated-default sentences with: 'DSPM requires explicit opt-in before processing organisational data; analytics in Insider Risk Management and DLP must be enabled before it can generate insights.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/data-security-posture-management-application-card. Retain the separate documented Posture Agent activation requirement.
